units.source_text: 5月黄昏，从学校回到家里，我经常从叔父家的二楼书斋眺望对面的小山。

en.t: On May evenings, after coming home from school, I would often look out from the second-floor study in my uncle's house at the little hill opposite.

units.source_text: 承受着夕照的翠绿的山腰，恍如在原野中央竖起的一扇金屏风。

en.t: The green mountainside, catching the evening light, looked just like a golden folding screen set up in the middle of a field.

units.source_text: 目睹这番景象，我就联想起金阁来了。

en.t: When I saw that scene, it made me think of the Golden Pavilion.
